method: Reconstruct projects/tools from verified source-v6 archive; replay audited DD3D and fusion loader patches; verify all 198 files against local release context; normalize line endings and replace internal data/example paths. Runtime dependencies remain supplied by the delivered image.
hash_convention: image_context_sha256 hashes original context bytes; initial_port_sha256 and normalized_port_sha256 hash checkout bytes with CRLF normalized to LF. initial_port_sha256 records the first customer path adaptation; normalized_port_sha256 records final source.
post_import_changes: Remove trailing whitespace in changed imported files.
Adapt tools/dist_train.sh for checkout-relative execution, environment preservation, argument forwarding and single/multi-node launch.
